changed: A shared archive that carries the user's own figures (`userFigures`) is now stamped archive envelope v8 (archiveSchemaVersionUserFigures), joining the unreleased v8, so a reader that predates the section warns instead of dropping the definitions silently. requiredSchemaVersion takes includeUserFigures, false by default, and encodeArchive passes it in share mode only; a backup is never stamped on its account.
